comment: Lab Tuner AI players (docs/LAB_TUNER.md Part 2). One shared turn search (src/core/lab/players/player.gd); a profile picks its search size, noise, what it ignores and how it weighs a state. weights: the state score (src/core/lab/players/evaluator.gd), from the party's side; a profile's weights replace these. beam: lines kept per step; moveBeam: extra slots kept for lines that start with a move; depth: steps per turn; moveCells: tiles worth trying for the first move, moveCellsLate: for later ones; noise: random share added to each line's value; ignoreChance: chance per turn to ignore ignoreKinds, ignoreOps and the cards of ignoreLevers; boardBlindChance: chance per turn to ignore cards that push or pull. record: keep the per-turn option values (Part 3).
